$comment: auth-page archetype fixture. The form NAME deliberately avoids the anonymous-form word list (login/signin/register/otp/forgot/reset/public) that [R-022] keys on: an anonymous form must carry formSettings.access 5, and the compiler has no access channel — access is a post-push form-settings fact, not markup. So this fixture pins the auth-page ANATOMY (centred, width-capped card, no page chrome) and leaves the access/[R-041] contract to the live push.

children.name: entryTitle
children.content: Sign in to the asset register

assertions.statement: the entry card is centred and width-capped at 420px; the page carries NO header band and no meta strip
the blueprint's own buttons win over the Save/Back floor, with exactly one primary [R-007/R-057]
auth-page is not a capture archetype — no validationErrors/Save floor is appended below the card
